browser_tool_api_access: The browser web tool reported all three DataCite API URLs inaccessible; this was a tool access limitation, not proof of absent DOI records. Direct HTTPS requests returned HTTP 200 and matching JSON, and DOI resolution succeeded.
local_tooling: An initial local interpreter lacked pypdf before requests ran. Re-execution with an available pypdf interpreter completed the fresh fetch. This is unrelated to source availability.
interpretation: No observed canonical-page/PDF/registry identity mismatch or inaccessible primary paper in this bounded audit. Source availability and consistent metadata do not certify research validity or peer review.
